orders.priority_reason: Safety, not coverage: the current path can quit the client.
orders.objective: Give EXIT_CONFIRM an explicit decision that only ever taps 取消.

Measured on that dialog 2026-09-17: 取消 (orange, left) / 确定 (blue, right) / X (top right). A BTN_CLOSE ROI that lands on 确定 quits the client. It did not happen, but that was luck.

orders.verifier: popup gone and the page is a known non-POPUP page

a test pins 取消 as the only target

orders.objective: Model the two stages of a focused camp: the tutorial-hand stage and the radial-menu stage.
orders.why_now: The training route was live verified (4 hops) on 2026-09-16 and failed on 2026-09-17T04:41Z at SELECT_INFANTRY_CAMP (INFANTRY_CAMP_MENU_NOT_PROVEN, HOME->MAP). The frame shows the camp highlighted with a large tutorial hand and NO radial menu yet, so the brain picked SELECT_INFANTRY_CAMP and that tap carried the client to the map.
orders.root_cause_or_hypothesis: TARGET_INFANTRY_CAMP_HIGHLIGHTED matches the tutorial stage; BTN_OPEN_TRAINING_FROM_CAMP matches the menu stage. The brain treats the first as 'the menu is open'.
acceptance: a --goal TRAIN run converges without the camp tap
orders.fallback_action: WAITING_FOR_NATURAL_STATE if the tutorial stage is one-shot per account

orders.objective: Take the two states the operator pre-authorised when they appear naturally.
orders.why_now: Both are cheap and both are real product value.
orders.current_evidence: RECALL_MARCH: if MarchState.GATHERING is visible, run SELECT_MARCH_TO_RECALL -> RECALL_MARCH -> RETURNING -> IDLE (operationally sanctioned). START_RESEARCH: if a startable node appears, select node -> read cost -> START_RESEARCH -> queue IN_PROGRESS with a timer. BTN_START_RESEARCH currently has zero templates, so the node/cost reading has to be built first.
acceptance: a live verified episode for whichever state appears
no waiting for the state: if it is not there, fall through

rules: Capability-first. One verifiable work unit per commit.
A capability only moves lifecycle on a live episode with verifier_ok=true and screenshots.
Offline gates (corpus precision/recall) support a change; they never promote one.
Check knowledge/external/external_capability_map.json before writing a new implementation.
Reuse before build; source before README; tool before code; evidence before guess.
No new Manager, Scheduler or Registry.
Never raise or lower a global threshold to make one frame pass.
Exit 2 must mean a verifier failed, not that a stop was merely unlabelled.
